eligibility_evidence: Perform on-site and remote troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex network infrastructure issues.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Summary: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Network Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in a System Integrator to join our growing technical team. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Experience: Minimum 3 years of direct experience as a Network Engineer within a System Integrator (SI) environment. Routing & Switching: Solid hands-on experience with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP), VLANs, Trunking (802.1Q), STP/RSTP, EtherChannel, and HSRP/VRRP. Vendor Experience: Proficiency in configuring and deploying enterprise hardware (Cisco Catalyst/Nexus, Enterprise Routers, Access Points, Wireless LAN Controllers).
